brief: Make the design gate reject rule-site lines that have no [changed] or [left] marker, so a design that lists a site without saying what it plans for it is caught before the approval gate
gap_description: A rule site with no [changed]/[left] marker counted as changed, so a design could list a site without committing to a plan

brief: Record whether the new tests fail on the base commit and excuse inherited failures. When test-guardedness cannot parse the check output, say so; do not silently excuse every failure
gap_description: Excusal accepted partial parses (pytest ERROR, a later non-test step) and masked runs (-x, pnpm test && pytest with the inherited failure first)

brief: A mode that declares a required brief (a Knob with required=True) must refuse to start when the brief is missing or empty, before any run directory is created
gap_description: Run start accepted any value equal to the knob's default, and a brief's default is empty string, so a mode declaring a required brief still started with no brief at all
